periods.time: C-block second round, second match opening

name.zh: 一刀罗刹斩断天眼棋谱
name.en: Ittou Rasetsu Cuts Off Sky Eye's Script

periods.summary: Byakuya predicts a twenty-three-move victory over Ikki, but Ikki opens the match with Ittou Rasetsu and ends Byakuya's consciousness immediately.
periods.cause: Byakuya believes Ikki cannot afford to spend Ittou Shura/Rasetsu before a likely same-day match with Sara, because Sara can reproduce Ikki copies and Ikki needs his trump card to survive later rounds.
periods.process: Before the match, Byakuya explains to Moroboshi that he has modeled Ikki's constraints and sees the checkmate when Ikki would use Shinkirou on the twenty-third move. Moroboshi warns him not to assume Ikki will act predictably. Once the match begins, Byakuya's planned intellectual duel is cut off before it can unfold.
periods.outcome: Byakuya's memory stops at the start signal with the sound of Ikki invoking Ittou Rasetsu, implying instant defeat or incapacitation.
periods.aftermath: The chapter ends on this reversal, leaving the wider consequences for Ikki's same-day stamina and next match unresolved.
casualties: Byakuya loses consciousness at the opening
periods.significance: Shows Ikki rejecting the obvious resource-conservation logic and defeating a prediction specialist by choosing the move Byakuya believed impossible.
